entities.name: Chaos Wall
entities.description: Hard border between the Edge and the Blind Eternities, a chaotic barrier of recombinant particles.

entities.name: The Edge
entities.description: Plane enclosed by the Chaos Wall.

entities.name: Blind Eternities
entities.description: Space between planes lying beyond the wall.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Multiverse inhabitants who accessed the Edge; source of ejecta contamination.

entities.name: Fomori
entities.description: Edge inhabitants who may have originated beyond the wall.

entities.name: Drix
entities.description: People whose myth informs understanding of the wall.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: Planeswalker who was one of the ejecta.

entities.name: Fomori-Eldrazi war
entities.description: War whose Eldrazi contamination makes up most ejecta.

events.summary: Tezzeret is expelled from the Chaos Wall as one of its ejecta.
events.quote: One of these ejecta was the planeswalker Tezzeret .

relations.note: It is the hard border between the Edge and the Blind Eternities.
relations.quote: the hard border between the Edge and the Blind Eternities of the Multiverse
